identity: Listen carefully:  not everything we gather comes from places like this.  Sometimes, we find places we call "labyrinths."  Stairs down to other worlds.  We keep track of them.  And, one is nearby, spotted by Benzete themselves.  These places aren't safe, and they aren't friendly.  But, they seem made for us, which is convenient, if you don't think too hard about it.  Honestly, it's where most of our bionics come from.

identity: UPTICK IN UFO SIGHTINGS CONCERN THE PUBLIC.  There has been a decidedly large increase in UFO sightings among the general public, among all ages, races, and classes.  Government spokesperson Jamie Vargas had the following to say.  "All these UFO sightings are due to climate change impacting the Aurora Borealis," she told an assembled press.  "There certainly aren't any aliens making contact with the US government and there aren't any aliens flying around.  You can count on that!"

entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of item 'disconnected bulk liquid tank'
identity: A heavy rack of ten interconnected steel tanks providing 600 liters of liquid storage.  It is built for stationary use, includes electric heating to keep its contents from freezing, and can accept plumbing equipment once placed as an appliance.
